# IOracleRegistryErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IOracleRegistryErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IOracleRegistryErrors

Interface defining errors used in OracleRegistry.


## Errors
### InvalidTicker
Reverted when the provided ticker string is empty or invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidTicker();
```

### InvalidAsset
Reverted when the provided asset address is zero or invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidAsset();
```

### InvalidOracle
Reverted when the provided oracle address is zero or invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidOracle();
```

### InvalidAddress
Reserved; not currently thrown by OracleRegistry (zero-address
checks use InvalidAsset / InvalidOracle instead).


```solidity
error InvalidAddress();
```
